channel.title: Hala Shamaly Blog
channel.description: Practical articles on GEO and AI search visibility.

item.title: Why AI Gets Your Brand Wrong, and How to Fix It
item.description: AI tools sometimes put brands in the wrong category. Why it happens, how to spot it, and the steps that moved Forlanso from freelance marketplace to remote workforce management.

item.title: Answer-First Writing: How to Structure Content So AI Can Quote It
item.description: A practical guide to writing quotable content for AI answers: lead with the answer, name things clearly, use lists and tables, and make every section stand on its own.

item.title: Does ChatGPT Mention Your Brand? A 10-Minute AI Visibility Check
item.description: A simple, free way to see whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Mode mention your brand: which questions to ask, what to record, and how to read the results.

item.title: What Is GEO? And How Is It Different From SEO?
item.description: GEO is optimizing your brand to be mentioned and cited inside ChatGPT, Gemini and Google answers. How it differs from SEO, and what your brand can do this week.

item.title: llms.txt: What Is It, and Does Your Brand Need One?
item.description: A guide to the proposed llms.txt file that points AI models to your site's most important pages: what it looks like, how to write it, and what it does and does not do.

item.title: How Qoyod Became the Source ChatGPT Cites for Accounting Templates
item.description: A blog full of knowledge, but AI found no answer worth quoting. How we rebuilt Qoyod's templates to reach page one in under 24 hours.
